description: This file defines Joi schemas for validating curriculum data structures, including chapter-based and block-based schemas, as well as superblock configurations. It exports validation functions for these schemas.

methods.name: superblockSchemaValidator
methods.description: Returns a validation function that validates a superBlock object based on whether it belongs to chapterBasedSuperBlocks or not.

methods.name: availableSuperBlocksValidator
methods.description: Returns a validation function for the availableSuperBlocks schema.
